packageRules.description: Disable devbox Go version updates, as they are taken care by our bosh-package-golang-release-based automation
Disable bosh-cli version update, due to https://github.com/cloudfoundry/bosh-utils/issues/86
Disable fly version updates — must match deployed Concourse server version manually
Group Ginkgo CLI and library updates together

Temporarily pin Ginkgo to v2.32.0: v2.32.1 makes our unit tests flaky while the devbox Ginkgo CLI lags the library (CLI/library must match). The root go.mod uses a `replace` to hold v2.32.0 against CF transitive deps that require v2.32.1. Remove this rule and the go.mod replace once the devbox CLI catches up.

Block the broken github.com/tedsuo/ifrit digest 94822c9: it log.Fatalf's on http server shutdown error, exiting the process and making unit tests on main flaky. Any other (e.g. fixed) digest is still allowed. See https://github.com/tedsuo/ifrit/issues/47 and reverted PR https://github.com/cloudfoundry/app-autoscaler/pull/1390
Group Cloud Foundry Logging and Metrics updates together
Disable Liquibase updates due to Functional Source License (FSL)

Group together dependencies that are likely to have no impact on the result of the acceptance-tests. This is for speed-increase and to reduce the traffic-jam in the renovate-dependecy-dashboard <https://github.com/cloudfoundry/app-autoscaler/issues/832>.
